context: Tests whether the agent correctly runs Phase 2 of the coaching workflow — proposing exactly three hack angles with required elements, enforcing the spec template fields, capping features at three, requiring a stage-directions demo moment, and meeting the exit gate before moving on. Sam starts with five features and wants to skip to the timeline.

checklist.name: Phase announcement
checklist.description: The coach explicitly announces Phase 2 by name (e.g. 'Phase 2 — Spec it' or equivalent) before beginning Step A

checklist.name: Skip-ahead refused
checklist.description: The coach does NOT jump straight to the timeline when Sam asks to — Phase 2 steps are carried out first

checklist.name: Exactly three angles proposed
checklist.description: The coach proposes exactly three (not two, not four) hack angles in Step A

checklist.name: Angles include one-line description
checklist.description: Each of the three proposed angles includes a one-line description of the concept

checklist.name: Angles include demo moment as stage directions
checklist.description: Each of the three proposed angles includes a demo moment written as stage directions (Judge does X / system does Y / judge sees Z), not as an abstract concept

checklist.name: Angles include feasibility note
checklist.description: Each of the three proposed angles includes an explanation of what makes it feasible within 24 hours

checklist.name: Feature cap enforced
checklist.description: The final spec's 'What's in' section contains at most 3 items — Sam's original list of 5 features is cut down

checklist.name: All spec fields filled
checklist.description: The produced spec.md contains all required fields: Goal, User, Demo moment, What's in, What's out, Success in 24h, Red flags — none are blank

checklist.name: Concrete demo moment in spec
checklist.description: The Demo moment in spec.md is written as concrete stage directions (what the judge does, what the system does, what the judge sees) — NOT an abstract description

checklist.name: What's out names temptations
checklist.description: The 'What's out' section in spec.md explicitly names specific features that were cut (e.g. the dashboard, Slack notifications, or VS Code extension from Sam's original list)

checklist.name: Exit gate confirmed
checklist.description: The session log contains a Phase 2 Complete section confirming all fields are filled and the demo moment meets the stage-directions requirement

checklist.name: No code started
checklist.description: The coach does NOT suggest writing any code or implementation steps during Phase 2
